rules: Map every requirement ID to implementation paths and actual test IDs/results.
A pass requires an assertion at the minimum stated level; mocks do not count as real Apple runtime.
Apple/evaluation external unavailability is explicit; incomplete core code is not a platform skip.
This file contains planned requirements only. No tests were executed to generate it.
Add further regressions as implementation uncovers concrete defects.
